breaking_news.headline: A hot summer trend in the sharing economy? Rental swimming pools
breaking_news.summary: The Airbnb-style company Swimply said there have been about 275,000 private pool reservations so far this year.

breaking_news.headline: But first, coffee: The drink that energized the American Revolution
breaking_news.summary: Colonial Americans were drinking coffee long before they dumped tea into Boston Harbor or fought a war for independence. The establishments that served it were already brewing revolutionary ideas.

breaking_news.headline: Egg producers settle with DOJ, states over price-fixing complaint
breaking_news.summary: Seventeen states and the Department of Justice have settled a case of alleged price-fixing by major egg producers. Egg prices soared in recent years but have since fallen sharply.

breaking_news.headline: Hate food waste? 7 creative ways to turn your leftovers into a new meal
breaking_news.summary: We asked our audience to share their favorite go-to recipes for leftovers. Here are seven dishes — like stuffed peppers and a biryani casserole — that can help you use up all your fridge scraps.

breaking_news.headline: Meet 'Project 2029' — and its war on the annoyance economy
breaking_news.summary: Remember Project 2025? Democrats are building their own governing blueprint, and one proposal takes aim at the "annoyance economy": robocalls, endless hold times, hidden fees and other everyday frustrations.

breaking_news.headline: This factory was severely short on workers. Then it offered flexible work
breaking_news.summary: A GE Appliances plant in rural northwest Georgia was short hundreds of workers amid COVID-19. A flexible work option where some workers can sign up for shifts through an app has eased the pain.

breaking_news.headline: Tensions with Iran add fresh uncertainty to an already shaky global economy
breaking_news.summary: Crude oil prices jumped and stock prices fell after President Trump declared an end to the ceasefire with Iran, adding fresh uncertainty to an already shaky outlook for the global economy.

breaking_news.headline: Should you sign your kids up for Trump Accounts? Four things to consider
breaking_news.summary: Families can still benefit even if their children aren't eligible for the free $1,000 contribution from the federal government.

breaking_news.headline: Arizona toddler found alive in hospital morgue after declared dead from drowning
breaking_news.summary: After he was discovered to still be alive, the 18-month-old was flown to another hospital and survived.

breaking_news.headline: Teenager arrested after two girls, 13, seriously injured in German school attack
breaking_news.summary: Police said a major operation was under way in the area of Welfen-Gymnasium secondary school in Schongau, Bavaria.

breaking_news.headline: Nato allies announce £37bn for new missile project
breaking_news.summary: Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer will convene around a dozen leaders to discuss the programme in Ankara.

breaking_news.headline: German doctor jailed for murder of 15 patients and suspected of more
breaking_news.summary: The German palliative care doctor has been sentenced to life imprisonment for killing 15 of his patients.

breaking_news.headline: Justin Bieber joins Madonna, Shakira and BTS for Fifa World Cup final half-time show
breaking_news.summary: The Super Bowl-style show marks the Canadian singer's latest big performance after his comeback shows at Coachella.

breaking_news.headline: Starmer gifted gun and ammunition by Turkish president at Nato
breaking_news.summary: The weapon has not been brought back to the UK and has instead been left with British officials in Turkey.

breaking_news.headline: Ukraine to get licence to produce Patriot missiles, Trump says
breaking_news.summary: Although the Patriots are highly effective against Russia's ballistic missiles, they also have lengthy production times.

breaking_news.headline: US launches more strikes on Iran with blasts reported in south of country
breaking_news.summary: Trump says the attacks are "retribution for yesterday's bombing of ships by Iran". Iran earlier promised strong retaliation.

breaking_news.headline: Outcry as Meta lets users make AI images from public Instagram profile pics
breaking_news.summary: The tech giant said people can opt out - but privacy campaigners called it a "recipe for disaster".

breaking_news.headline: Hundreds of jobs at risk as John Lewis plans to cut some services
breaking_news.summary: No final decision has been made but the job cuts will happen in the autumn if the redundancy plans are approved.

breaking_news.headline: Wealthy AI workers send San Francisco house prices soaring
breaking_news.summary: The median cost of a home in the city is now $1.7m, a record high, according to the latest figures.

breaking_news.headline: Online marketplaces still selling dozens of unsafe baby products, Which? finds
